strengths: Very large context window: strong for whole-codebase or long-document reads

weaknesses: Tool use ergonomics differ from Anthropic/OpenAI patterns
Less mature ecosystem of structured-output libraries
prompting_quirks: Lean into the long context: feed whole repos, full transcripts
Function calling syntax differs; check Google AI docs
Performance on very long contexts is the differentiator
